title: Recommended buffer policy
content: OnTime+ recommends adding a buffer to your travel time so that you arrive on time even with typical variability. Default policy: buffer = max(8 minutes, 1 standard deviation of travel time, plus alert added time). For high-stakes events (exam, interview), buffer = 1.5 standard deviations.

title: Risk labelling rules
content: An itinerary is labelled RELIABLE if (a) the buffer is at least 10 minutes, AND (b) there is no active alert affecting any segment in the chosen route. It is labelled RISKY if buffer < 3 minutes OR there is a moderate-or-higher alert on the route. Otherwise label CAUTION.

title: Peak hour definition
content: Peak hours are defined as Monday-Friday 07:00-09:30 (morning) and 16:30-19:00 (evening). All other times are off-peak. Use peak travel times during these windows.
